title: Piano competitions and bucking contests
summary: Pianists took turns to see who was best; he names Red Cayou, Little Willie, the Katos, One-Leg Alex and Blind Frank.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Did you ever get in any competition with other piano players?

Oh, yeah, that's all time to meet that. Oh, yeah? Oh, yeah, you know all the time. How did that work? You'd meet Lil Willa and you'd get in a place and what fella would be playing and then two, three might be there to play and everybody go to bucking one another. Did you take turns on the piano? Yeah, everybody take a turn, want to see who could play the best. Like I remember they had this Red Caillou, they had Lil Willa, they had Lil Kato and Big Kato, they had One Leg Alex Seed, and they had the old Blind Frank uptown. And myself, sometime we'd run across them uptown up there around the Garden District and we'd go on to bucking. Oh, and that fella too I'll forget to tell you about, Udell.
Oh, yeah, I'm afraid of him. What's his last name?
Oh, I done forgot, I'd forgotten either. I know Udell used to live up in Colton there. I'd run across him a couple of times and I'd play against him.
Well, did you have to play the same numbers or you could play your own numbers?
Just play with this play, and I'm going to play what you want. Just play what you want, and then the people that like it, they'd be classy about who's the best and who ain't the best.
How'd they decide? Did they clap real hard or judge or something?
Well, they'd be happy with Hollywood's the best and who ain't. Everybody, let me tell you we play the best, alright.
